consentDisclaimer.label: Disclaimer
consentDisclaimer.collapsedText:
I/ we hereby acknowledge and agree to the following terms and conditions. 
1. Loan offer is from Kotak Mahindra Prime Limited (KMPL), a subsidiary of Kotak Mahindra Bank limited. Loan sanction and disbursement will be subject to complete documentation and credit approval at sole discretion of KMPL and subject to guidelines issued by RBI from time to time
expandedExtraItems: By filling up this form and sharing your mobile number with KMPL, you are hereby giving your consent to KMPL to extract your information from the Credit Bureau.
KMPL may engage the services of marketing agents for the purpose of sourcing loan assets. Available at select locations.

By sending an SMS/ calling us / clicking on the links mentioned, you are hereby giving your consent to receive call/communication from Kotak Mahindra Prime Ltd and other Kotak Group Companies for marketing purposes through telephone/Mobile/SMS/Email for the selected financial product (Car Finance / Two-Wheeler Loan / Loan Against Property) and that such consent shall prevail over any current or subsequent registration of your number in the National Do Not Call Registry.

Schemes like Balloon EMI/ Step-Up EMI / Bullet EMI / Subvention scheme (if applicable) are for a limited period only and KMPL may withdraw/suspend/revoke these schemes anytime without any advance notice.

Subvention scheme (if applicable) is a limited period offer based on subventions offered by select car dealerships or OEMs and KMPL is not responsible or liable for products and services offered by the dealer or OEM . Only available for select vehicle models.
consentDisclaimer.helperTextAlwaysVisible: By clicking on Apply now, I agree to the above terms

readMoreFeatureBanner.description: 'Margin Money Scheme' banner read-more expand, shown on New Car Finance and (reusing identical content) Car Lease pages.

content.heading: Margin Money Scheme
content.body: We offer a car loan covering up to 100% of the invoice value for new cars for select models.

content.heading: Margin Money Scheme
content.body:
We provide finance for acquisition of new car up to 100% of the invoice value for certain models.

The customer should pay the margin money (invoice value minus the finance amount) to the dealer directly. He also has an option to pay the margin money to KMPL upon which we would release the entire invoice value to the Dealer.

The financed amount can be repaid as per your convenience (12 - 84 months EMIs).

crossCuttingNotes: No validation-error or success states were present in any provided frame for the lead form or read-more components.
Both the lead-form modal and the read-more modal share the same chrome pattern on desktop: #000000cc scrim, 580px white card, 32px radius, 40x40/8px-radius close control above the top-right corner.

Both the lead-form full-screen sheet (implicit) and read-more full-screen sheet share the same sticky-footer gradient-fade pattern as the product-page sticky bottom CTA: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.80) 100%) behind a full-width black pill 'Apply now' button.
